$comment: Generated from crates/kinora-project; do not edit. Regenerate with `cargo run -p kinora-ipc --example generate`.

Animated_ParamValue.description: A property that is either constant or animated by keyframes.

oneOf.description: The same value for the whole clip.

Interpolated between keyframes, held before the first and after the
last. At least one keyframe, ordered by strictly increasing `at`.

Animated_Vec2.description: A property that is either constant or animated by keyframes.

oneOf.description: The same value for the whole clip.

Interpolated between keyframes, held before the first and after the
last. At least one keyframe, ordered by strictly increasing `at`.

Animated_double.description: A property that is either constant or animated by keyframes.

oneOf.description: The same value for the whole clip.

Interpolated between keyframes, held before the first and after the
last. At least one keyframe, ordered by strictly increasing `at`.

fadeIn.description: Fade-in length from the clip start, `>= 0`.

fadeOut.description: Fade-out length before the clip end, `>= 0`.

gainDb.description: Gain in decibels; `0` leaves the level unchanged.

oneOf.description: Multiply or screen depending on the base.

CaptionWord.description: A word inside a caption cue.

end.description: When the word ends, relative to the clip start; `>= start`.

start.description: When the word starts, relative to the clip start.

Clip.description:
An item on a track.

Timing: the clip occupies `[start, start + duration)` on the timeline. For
media, the source range is derived, never stored twice:
`sourceIn .. sourceIn + duration × speed` (rounded to the flick, see
[`Speed::source_duration`]). Every time here is on the edit grid
(ADR-0004 amendment 2).

audio.description:
Sound properties; required on audio tracks, optional for video media
with sound, `null` otherwise.

content.description: What the clip shows or plays.

enabled.description: A disabled clip is kept but neither drawn nor heard.

name.description: Display name override; `null` shows the content's name.

visual.description:
Picture properties; required on video, text and caption tracks,
`null` on audio tracks.

ClipContent.description: What a clip shows or plays.

oneOf.description: A range of a media file (video and audio tracks).

media.description: The asset in the media pool.

preservePitch.description: Keeps the pitch of sped-up or slowed-down sound.

sourceIn.description:
Where playback starts in the source, `>= 0`. With `reverse`, the
clip plays the same source range backwards.

words.description:
Word timings for karaoke-style highlighting; empty when unknown.
Ordered and non-overlapping. Words outside the clip (after a trim or
split) are kept but not shown.

oneOf.description: Applies the clip's effects to everything below it (video tracks).

ClipId.description: Identifies a clip on a track.

Color.description:
An RGBA colour: sRGB-encoded components in `0..=1`, straight (not
premultiplied) alpha.

ColorSpace.description:
Colour spaces. Phase 1 renders Rec. 709 only; the HDR variants exist so
the format does not need a new version when HDR arrives (P5+).

oneOf.description: ITU-R BT.709 primaries and transfer (SDR video, close to sRGB).
ITU-R BT.2100 with the PQ transfer (HDR10).
ITU-R BT.2100 with the HLG transfer.

ContentHash.description:
A fast fingerprint of a file's content.

Not a cryptographic hash: it detects that a file was replaced or matches a
candidate during relink, quickly, even for files of many gigabytes.

digest.description: The digest as lowercase hexadecimal (32 characters for 128 bits).

fileSize.description: File size in bytes, part of the fingerprint. At most 2^53 − 1.

Crop.description:
How much of each edge of the source to cut away, as fractions of its
size; each `0..1`, and opposite edges sum to less than `1`.

Easing.description: How a value moves from one keyframe to the next.

oneOf.description: Keep this keyframe's value until the next keyframe, then jump.

A CSS-style cubic Bézier through `(0,0)`, `(x1,y1)`, `(x2,y2)`, `(1,1)`.
`x1` and `x2` must be within `0..=1`.

EffectInstance.description: An effect applied to a clip.

enabled.description: A disabled effect is kept but skipped.

id.description: Stable identifier of this application of the effect.

params.description:
Parameter values by name; parameters left out take the manifest's
default.

EffectInstanceId.description: Identifies one applied effect on a clip.

EffectRef.description: A reference to an effect package (`effects/<id>/effect.toml`).

version.description:
Manifest version the parameters were written for; the effect migrates
older parameters when it loads them.

FontRef.description:
A typeface by family name. Fonts are resolved at render time from the
bundled open-licence fonts, then the system; a missing font falls back
and is reported, never silently substituted in the file.

FrameRate.description: Frames per second as an exact, positive rational num/den, e.g. 30000/1001.

oneOf.description:
XXH3-128 over the file size and three fixed-size samples (start,
middle, end) of the file (ADR-0004 §2). `kinora-media` defines the
exact sampling; changing it requires a new variant.

Keyframe_ParamValue.description: A value at a point in time.

at.description:
When, relative to the start of the owning clip, so moving the clip
moves its animation. May lie outside `0..=clip.duration` after a trim
or split, which keep keyframes in place relative to the content.

easing.description: Interpolation from this keyframe to the next one.

Keyframe_Vec2.description: A value at a point in time.

at.description:
When, relative to the start of the owning clip, so moving the clip
moves its animation. May lie outside `0..=clip.duration` after a trim
or split, which keep keyframes in place relative to the content.

easing.description: Interpolation from this keyframe to the next one.

Keyframe_double.description: A value at a point in time.

at.description:
When, relative to the start of the owning clip, so moving the clip
moves its animation. May lie outside `0..=clip.duration` after a trim
or split, which keep keyframes in place relative to the content.

easing.description: Interpolation from this keyframe to the next one.

Marker.description: A named point or range on a timeline (also exported as chapters).

MarkerId.description: Identifies a marker on a timeline.

MediaAsset.description: One file in the media pool.

hash.description: Fingerprint of the file's content, for relinking and change detection.

id.description: Stable identifier; clips refer to the asset by it.

info.description: Stream properties found when the file was imported.

name.description: Display name, initially the file name.

origin.description: Imported by the user or produced by Kinora.

MediaId.description: Identifies an asset in the media pool.

MediaInfo.description: Stream properties of a media file.

audio.description: The primary audio stream, if any.

duration.description:
Length of the file; `null` for still images, which last as long as
their clip.

video.description: The primary video stream, if any.

MediaKind.description: The kind of a media file.

MediaLocation.description: Where a media file is on disk.

absolutePath.description: Absolute path when last seen, e.g. `D:\Footage\beach.mp4`.

relativePath.description:
Path relative to the `.kinora` project folder with `/` separators,
e.g. `../Footage/beach.mp4` or `media/beach.mp4` after "Collect media".
Tried first, so a project folder moved together with its media still
resolves. `null` when the file is on another drive.

oneOf.description:
Produced by Kinora: text-to-speech, a background cutout, an upscale, a
voiceover recording. Can be regenerated from its source.

source.description: The asset it was derived from, if any.

ParamValue.description:
The value of one effect or transition parameter.

Externally tagged so the type is explicit and compact:
`{ "float": 0.5 }`, `{ "color": { "r": 1, "g": 0, "b": 0, "a": 1 } }`.
The effect's manifest (`effects/<id>/effect.toml`) declares which type each
parameter has; every keyframe of a parameter has the same type.

oneOf.description: One of the options the effect declares, by its identifier.

ProjectId.description: Identifies a project. Survives "save as" so caches can be shared.

colorSpace.description: Colour space the compositor works and exports in.

Rational.description: Exact rational number num/den (ADR-0004). Readers normalise to lowest terms.

num.description: Numerator, within ±(2^53 − 1) so JavaScript reads it exactly.

SchemaVersion.description: Document format version. This schema describes exactly this version.

Speed.description:
Playback speed of a media clip.

A tagged union so speed curves (P2) can be added as a new variant.

oneOf.description:
A fixed multiplier, `> 0`: `2` is twice as fast, `1/2` is slow motion.
Exact, so source and timeline durations convert without drift.

TextBackground.description: A box drawn behind the text.

padding.description: Padding around the text in ems, `>= 0`.

background.description: Box behind the text, if any.

letterSpacing.description: Extra space between letters, in ems.

lineHeight.description: Line height as a multiple of the font size, `> 0`.

size.description: Font size as a fraction of the canvas height, `> 0`.

Time.description:
A point or a span on a time axis, in seconds, as an exact rational.

The same type serves positions (a clip's start), durations (its length)
and offsets (a keyframe relative to its clip); the field name says which.
Negative values are representable because offsets can be negative; the
document validator decides where they are allowed.

Serialised exactly like [`Rational`]: `{ "num": 1001, "den": 30000 }`.

Timeline.description: A timeline (sequence): a canvas and a stack of tracks.

tracks.description:
Tracks in compositing order: index 0 is drawn first (the bottom
layer). Audio tracks are mixed regardless of order.

TimelineId.description: Identifies a timeline (a sequence) within the project.

Track.description: A row of clips of one kind.

transitions.description: Transitions between adjacent clips of this track.

TrackId.description: Identifies a track within a timeline.

TrackKind.description: Track kinds; each accepts certain clip contents (see [`ClipContent`]).

oneOf.description: Video and image media, solids and adjustment layers.
Audio, from audio files or the sound of video files.

Transform.description:
Placement of a clip on the canvas.

Coordinates are fractions of the canvas, origin at its centre, `+y` down:
`(0.5, 0)` puts the anchor on the right edge. Resolution-independent, so a
timeline can be resized without moving anything.

anchor.description:
Pivot for scale and rotation, as fractions of the clip from its
centre.

position.description: Where the anchor point sits on the canvas.

scale.description: Size relative to fitting the canvas; `(1, 1)` fits.

Transition.description:
A transition across the cut between two adjacent clips on one track,
centred on the cut.

duration.description: Length, `> 0` and no longer than either clip.

from.description: The clip that ends at the cut.

to.description: The clip that starts at the cut.

TransitionId.description: Identifies a transition between two clips.

y.description: Vertical component (positive is down, as on screen).

VideoFormat.description: Canvas size and frame rate of a timeline.

VideoStreamInfo.description: Properties of a video (or image) stream.

colorSpace.description: Colour space as signalled by the file; `null` when unspecified.

frameRate.description: Nominal frame rate; `null` for variable frame rate or still images.

hasAlpha.description: `true` when the stream carries an alpha channel.

blendMode.description: How the clip combines with the layers below.

crop.description: Cropping of the source, applied before the transform.

timelines.description:
Timelines (sequences), e.g. a 16:9 cut and a 9:16 cut of the same
material. At least one.
